229:
You can fight in melee with bare hands or with melee weapons.
Melee fight proceeds automatically when you are close to an enemy. Each weapon has a different chance to cause triple damage or a chance to block an enemy attack.
230:
With ranged weapons, aiming takes place automatically. Shoot by using the button.
Shooting while running is less accurate than while standing.
231: The fireplace provides heat, light and a cooking possibility. It can be used up to three times once built.
232: You can grow plants which will provide you with food. You need seeds and a shovel, pitchfork or pickaxe to plant.
233: You’ll need resources for crafting. You can find or gather them.
234: When you’re injured, you can start bleeding. You can’t regenerate while bleeding and you constantly lose blood. Use bandages or rags to stop the bleeding.
235: You can catch a disease if your temperature drops to 0% or, in rare cases, if you’re attacked by infected. You can’t regenerate while diseased. To cure the disease, use tetracycline or maintain your temperature, food and water statuses over 75%.
237: Cold weather can bring your temperature down. During the night, rain or snow, the temperature decreases even more.
238: You need to eat and drink to survive. Check the status bars for your hunger and thirst. If they drop under 50%, you can't regenerate your blood status bar.
254: If blood drops to zero, you die. You can lose blood from being attacked in melee or from being hit by bullets. You'll also start losing blood if your heat/water/food drops to zero.
255: You can stop bleeding with bandages or rags (some clothes can be torn into rags).
256: Use blood bags and saline bags to restore blood.
257: If your water, food and heat are all over 50%, you will start regenerating blood.
260: Hide inside buildings to warm up.
261: Find warm clothing in a good condition to warm up.
263: Start a campfire to warm up.
264: Find a tent and deploy it to hide inside from the rain and to warm up a little.
266: Most of the loot can be found in buildings.
267: Loot can also be found in car trunks.
268: You can find edible berries on some bushes.
270:
You can chop down trees with an axe. Different types of trees provide different resources.
All other useful items can be found in the world.
272: Find a headlamp or night vision goggles to illuminate the night (requires batteries).
273: Flares can illuminate a small area for a brief period after they’re thrown.
274: The fireplace can also illuminate an area for a longer period during the night.
276: Water pumps may contain water for drinking. You can drink from them, but keep in mind water is limited.
277: You can also fill bottles and canteens from water pumps.
279: Duct tape adds 15% condition to some gear.
280: Sewing kit adds 50% condition to some gear.
281: Cleaning kit adds 25% condition to your firearm.
283: You can find deer near water or in forests. They’re wary so you need a ranged weapon to hunt them.
284: If you shoot a deer you can flay it with a knife to get meat steaks.
285: Meat steaks can be cooked with a fireplace.

291: Improvised bag + 3 wooden sticks = improvised backpack (5 slots)
